t: The Titan TTI1230PRW cordless hand-held pressure washer is a compact solution for light-duty cleaning on site or at home. Running on an 18V 5Ah Li-ion TXP battery, it delivers up to 22 bar pressure with a 126L/hr flow rate. The 6m suction hose draws water from fresh sources, supporting mobile use without mains supply. A 5-in-1 adjustable nozzle allows controlled spray patterns for vehicles, bikes and outdoor equipment. Lightweight construction and auto stop/start improve efficiency and handling.
